metadata.name: Documentation Gap Detection Test Suite
metadata.description: Example test cases for clinical documentation gap detection

test_cases.clinical_note: A 65-year-old male presents with chest pain on exertion that resolves with rest. EKG shows ST depressions in leads V4-V6 during exercise. Cardiac catheterization scheduled.
expected_gaps: Severity of angina not documented (stable vs unstable)

test_cases.clinical_note: A 58-year-old female with type 2 diabetes. Last HbA1c was 8.5%. Currently on metformin 1000mg twice daily. Patient reports good compliance with medications.
expected_gaps: Date of last HbA1c not specified
Diabetic complications screening not documented (retinopathy, nephropathy, neuropathy)

test_cases.clinical_note: A 72-year-old male with COPD presents with productive cough and dyspnea. Increased inhaler use over past week. Started on prednisone 40mg daily and azithromycin.
A 45-year-old female with chronic low back pain for 6 months. Pain radiates to left leg. Takes ibuprofen with partial relief. Requesting stronger pain medication.
expected_gaps: Red flag symptoms assessment not documented

test_cases.clinical_note: A 68-year-old male with atrial fibrillation. Currently on metoprolol for rate control. Patient reports occasional palpitations but denies syncope or chest pain.
expected_gaps: Heart rate and rhythm at visit not documented
